suggestions: decorrelate scalar aggregate subquery into CTE plus join
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
    select sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk,
           sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk,
           sum(SR_FEE) as ctr_total_return
    from store_returns, date_dim
    where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 2000
    group by sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk
)
SELECT c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
INNER JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
INNER JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT ctr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) AS avg_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
) AS store_avg ON store_avg.ctr_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > store_avg.avg_return * 1.2
  AND s_state = 'TN'
ORDER BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100
